bookmarkSyncDesc: Sync the HTML exported by Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari "Export bookmarks" into rows of a SiYuan database (name / link / tags / description)
bookmarkHintDesc: First use "Export bookmarks" in your browser to get an HTML file. In SiYuan just insert a Database block — the fields (name / link / tags / description) are set up for you by the "Tidy columns" button in the dialog: the primary key is renamed and moved first, the built-in single-select "Tags" column is converted to multi-select in place (values kept), stray empty single-select columns are deleted, and columns are ordered name → link → tags → description. Tags are auto-classified from bookmark folder paths (make folders like Tools / Netdisk / Dev / AI…); unfiled bookmarks fall back to the domain. Missing descriptions can be fetched automatically from each page's meta description. Dropped bookmark files are auto-saved to the workspace at /data/bookmarks/ and reloaded when the dialog opens — no paths to type, works on Docker.
bookmarkDropHint: Click or drag the HTML produced by your browser's "Export bookmarks" (multiple allowed). It is auto-saved to /data/bookmarks/ and reloaded next time you open this dialog.
bookmarkFetchDesc: Fetch page description into the Description column
bookmarkResetConfirm: After resetting, the next sync rewrites every checked bookmark into the database (existing rows are matched by URL, no duplicates). Continue?
